body:
## Install

Needs Windows (x64 or arm64) and Claude Code or Codex, installed and signed in. In PowerShell, run:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod 'https://github.com/storytree-ai/storytree/releases/latest/download/install-storytree.ps1')))
```

It installs the app and opens it; Help → First-run guide in the app connects your agent.

Windows x64 and arm64 installer, built from verified merged main d89735bfd6dc6a84f0491320e8daccfc5244ad5a. The installed app follows this release feed automatically.
